How lane styles fit

The general rule behind these picks:

  • Lane bullies (Draven, Samira, Lucian) + engage or catch supports (Leona, Nautilus, Blitzcrank): fight early and often.
  • Scaling carries (Jinx, Vayne, Kog'Maw) + enchanters or wardens (Lulu, Milio, Braum): survive lane, then dominate late.
  • Long-range poke (Caitlyn, Ezreal, Varus) + poke mages (Lux, Xerath): win trades from a distance and take towers.
  • Utility marksmen (Ashe, Jhin) + engage: their slows and roots chain with the support's crowd control.

Playing with a friend? Look up your lane matchup in the Matchup Lookup and plan your build with the Game Plan Builder.
